mapper.select: SELECT user_id, activity_type, resource_id, occurred_at FROM user_last_activities WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_last_activities (user_id, activity_type, resource_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityType}, #{resourceId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE activity_type = new.activity_type, resource_id = new.resource_id, occurred_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
